items.answer: Private labeling means you launch a immune support product under your own brand using one of our pre-existing, doctor-formulated stock formulas. We handle production, quality testing, and bottling. You select the formulation from our catalog, design your label, and we produce the finished product ready to ship under your brand. No formulation work, no setup fees, no lab build-out.
items.question: What does private labeling immune support supplements actually involve?

items.answer: Most immune support formulations have minimum order quantities in the low hundreds of bottles per SKU. Once your labels are approved, production typically takes three to four weeks before your first inventory ships. Custom packaging or formulation can extend that timeline. We give you exact MOQs and lead times for the SKUs you select during your consultation.
items.question: What are typical minimums and lead times for immune support products?

items.answer: Yes. All our immune support formulations are produced in our FDA-registered, GMP-certified Vermont facility. Our formulations meet dietary supplement labeling requirements under DSHEA. Each batch is tested for identity, potency, and contaminants. You receive Certificates of Analysis with your inventory. We help you understand the structure-function claims you can responsibly make on your label.
items.question: Are these immune support products FDA-compliant?

items.answer: Total launch cost depends on the SKUs you choose, the packaging you select, and the volume you order. Most clients launch a 3-5 SKU immune support line for under $15,000 in initial inventory, including custom label design. There are no setup fees, no annual contracts, and no formulation costs for private label. We provide transparent SKU-by-SKU pricing during your consultation.
